question: Can a small sequential task with genuinely different two-link compositional causal laws, hidden unannounced decoder changes, paid internal interventions and persistent repeated-law blocks be identified without a shortcut or privileged labels, with room for strong conventional controls and new Yggdrasil-native non-token learners?
north_star: Independent native non-transformer non-token causal learning; MD32 is a task/physics qualification, NOT a learner or integration.

law_family.semantics: Stage0 chooses the publicly required precursor channel a, which latches hidden h=encoder[a]. Stage1 chooses terminal actuator b. Correct iff b=decoder[h]. The decoder is composed of a motif-local mapping and a hidden cyclic four-output offset. Rewire composes an additional +1 cyclic shift to the decoder after the irreversible stage0 choice, with no public change flag. Encoder and decoder are distinct physical mechanisms; neither may be observed without a charged intervention.
law_family.topology_boundary: Source motif map pairs and composition semantics are frozen; train and unfamiliar transfer contain three disjoint primitive mechanism combinations; functional/structural signatures must be unique across six motifs. All four hidden decoder offsets occur per motif in synthetic fixture.
law_family.possible_degeneracy: Some distinct mechanisms can induce the same input-output composition on one context; evaluating by motif alone is not proof of learning or general intelligence.

physical_contract.public_required_precursor: Four-episode law block forces a different contextual precursor in episodes 0,1,2,3 to prevent trivial action-repeat policy.
physical_contract.stage0_paid_diagnostic: Probe encoder channel a (the current required precursor); returns a 4-bit one-hot of encoder[a]. At most one diagnostic stage0.
physical_contract.stage0_irreversible_actuator: Commit the required precursor a; changes hidden latch h and returns all-zero public sensor vector. Costs 0.02.
physical_contract.stage1_paid_diagnostic: Probe decoder at any intermediate channel h in 0..3; returns a 4-bit one-hot of decoder[h] for the current stage. At most one diagnostic stage1.
physical_contract.stage1_irreversible_actuator: Choose terminal channel b; correct final reward +0.98, incorrect -0.52, reflecting final cost 0.02. No answer is revealed until physically acting.
physical_contract.net_utility: Correct 2-actuator no-probe oracle: +0.96; correct two-probe physical strategy: +0.80; wrong two-actuator policy: -0.54.
physical_contract.observation: Public stage, four sensor bits, current required precursor, permitted diagnostic menu, remaining physical diagnostic count, and paid public action history only. No motif, offset, true graph, latent h, rewire flag, terminal answer, seed, or oracle pointer.
physical_contract.no_root_preview: Stage1 decoder diagnostic can query an intermediate channel only; guessing which channel matters without stage0 encode knowledge may waste the sole decoder probe.
physical_contract.stage1_ambient_invariance: Stable and rewired worlds with same seed, stage0 precursor and paid stage0 encoder probe must expose identical public stage1 observation before paid decoder diagnostic.
physical_contract.provenance: Public action/reward/sensor trace and canonical SHA; source fixture can know labels only in harness, never pass to a policy.

allocation.source_lock: Only synthetic fixtures with 9100<=seed<=9195 may be constructed; no official training/DEV/cold/registered cohort is generated by this task-first gate.
allocation.registered_first_use: FORBIDDEN until separate source/generator-control freeze and explicit owner approval; future seeds do not authorize exploration.
allocation.md30_md31_original_and_synthetic: Do not reuse MD29 reserve, MD30 official cohorts or MD31 scored 8301..8420, and never edit MD30/MD31 frozen sources/results.

preflight.oracle_definition: Privileged read-only full compositional mapping, no charged diagnostics, choose correct terminal actuator in 2 paid actuator steps. Diagnostic upper bound, not usable learner.
preflight.blind_definition: Without any probe, commit the required precursor then always choose terminal channel 0. All four output offsets per motif ensure exact 25% successes.
preflight.physical_probed_definition: Call physically charged encoder diagnostic at required precursor, commit precursor; call physically charged decoder diagnostic at observed hidden channel, choose observed terminal channel. Two paid diagnostics and two paid actuations.
preflight.required_identifiable_conditions: For every 96 fixture seed, same public initial and stage1 ambient observation across stable/rewired, correct terminal actions differ, a charged decoder intervention at the encoded channel distinguishes, and an externally observable public two-probe plan reaches final goal without any private labels.
preflight.diagnosis_if_no_go: Freeze negative TASK_NO_GO. Repair task only via new prereg/source record before any official first-use; no favorable learner tuning based on data.
preflight.strong_control_saturation_stop: Next gate must implement and fully train strong adaptive Bayesian/sequence/model-based controls with matched information and whole-process compute. If strongest control approaches oracle within 0.05 on disjoint transfer, freeze task as TRIVIAL_FOR_NOVEL_GAIN and do not spend on another unconventional learner.
preflight.scientific_pass: Not in this gate; oracle/blind and hand-coded physical two-probe success only establish task physics, not learned intelligence, transfer, cold retention or scientific gain.

qualification.mandatory: All existing 54 inherited + 32 MD30 + 7 MD31 focused tests and new MD32 preflight tests on final source SHA, G29 atlas final pinned source and byte-exact cross-platform physical receipts.
qualification.authority: Research-only isolated draft PR; no merge, native model, main, accepted refs, original first-use, controller, scheduler, runner, science promotion or third-party project changes.
qualification.outcome: If engineering passes, TASK_PHYSICS_PREFLIGHT_PASS only; publish caveat strong trained learner headroom UNVERIFIED.
